project_type: Research code: TensorFlow 2.10 groupwise 3D brain MRI registration (Keras models, custom training runtime, numpy/scipy/nibabel evaluator). No package build; scripts run in place.
language: Python (must parse as Python 3.8: cluster container tf10_nv.sif = py3.8.10, TF 2.10.0, numpy 1.21.1, scipy 1.4.1, nibabel 3.1.1; no PEP 585/604 annotations evaluated at runtime, no 3.9+ stdlib). Bash for slurm/*.sh.
build_system: None. Windows host (PowerShell 5.1) + WSL Ubuntu conda envs. Activate the skill 'shell-and-remote-jobs' before running anything non-trivial; write multi-line commands to .agents/tmp/*.sh and run them with `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tmp/<script>.sh`.
test_framework: unittest. Every TF test module imports `tests.tf_setup` FIRST (sets TF32 off and the GPU memory limit from BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB). Shared helpers: tests/runtime_helpers.py (tiny_config / TINY widths, free_memory, synthetic_group), tests/test_cascade.py (randomize(model, seed, scale), CascadeCase, CascadeTrainerCase.stages/make, ChainCase.frozen_models/chain/make1, chain_config, cascade_config, N_CLASSES=9, STAGE_KW), tests/test_trainer.py (_OpDeterminism), runtime/fixed_data.py (synthetic_deform_group, ValidationSet, DeformValidationSet).
build_command:
py3.8 syntax check (env bgr_preproc38): `source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate bgr_preproc38 && python - <files> <<'EOF'
import ast,sys
for f in sys.argv[1:]: ast.parse(open(f).read(), f, feature_version=(3, 8))
EOF`
test_command: One module (tf_gpu, needs the local GTX 1080): `cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad && source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tf_gpu && export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 && python -m unittest tests.<module> -v`. Full suite (~3 h, run in the background, poll the log): `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh > .agents/tmp/full_suite.log 2>&1`; it ends with 'suite status: 0' when green.
verification_instructions: 1) py3.8 ast check of every new/changed .py file in bgr_preproc38. 2) Run the new/changed test modules one per process in tf_gpu (command above). 3) Re-run the regression modules named in the FEAT (e.g. tests.test_split_group_conv, tests.test_group_layers, tests.test_cascade, tests.test_trainer). 4) The full suite (tests/run_tests_wsl.sh) runs once in the convergence fixer before the review; it must end with 'suite status: 0'. Print measured maxima in tests (the report needs them).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Golden fixtures under tests/fixtures/ (trainer goldens) must NOT change: the layers.py refactor is bit-identical. No generated files are committed. Task docs go to .agents/tasks/predict-script/ (committed with the code is fine; .agents/tmp/ is scratch).
environment_constraints: Local tf_gpu (py3.9.13, TF 2.10, numpy 1.23.4, scipy 1.13.0) has NO nibabel (verified 2026-11-01: ModuleNotFoundError). Installing it changes Jay's env: pause (send_message severity warning) with the exact command `conda activate tf_gpu && pip install nibabel==3.1.1` and wait for approval; never skipTest for missing nibabel. tf_gpu crashes when the GPU is hidden via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""; level-1 test work runs under `with tf.device('/CPU:0')` in the GPU process. GPU limit 6000 MB locally (GTX 1080). Cluster: never sbatch, never GPU work on glacier, never push from FEAT steps (push is a later workflow step). TF32 must stay off (models.precision.configure_tf_precision).
contribution_requirements: Branch main, no worktree; commit locally on main after each FEAT, never push. Follow existing conventions (docstrings naming the design section, plain argparse, logging). No changes to runtime/, main.py, evaluation/ (the design imports evaluation.evaluate.find_subjects/load_grid_data/spacing_of, evaluation.fields.warp/compose, evaluation.metrics.MajorityVote). models/ changes are pure refactors (bit-identical graphs). No new dependencies. Approved design: .agents/tasks/predict-script/design.md v5 (sections referenced as 'design N.M'); review NITs in design-review.md (check-streaming uses the FIRST --n-subjects subjects in find_subjects order, fewer -> exit 2; script header + report state what to do on exit 4).
key_patterns: GroupConvBlock (models/layers.py 653-711): _pre(x, training, concat) = norm -> act (-> group_mean_concat); call() uses _split_call when split_group and built; clip_fp16(x, c) adds no op when c == 0 or dtype != float16. GroupEncoder.call: stem (pre_activation False, never split) -> skips[0]; pool2 (level 1) -> l2 -> pool3 (levels 2/1) -> l3..l6 (l2 and l3 stride 1, l4/l5/l6 stride 2). DeformDecoder.call: x = cast(skips[5], compute_dtype); per stage d5..d1: x = cast(x, block.compute_dtype); up (d5,d4,d3 always; d2 at levels 2/1; d1 at level 1); block(concat([x, cast(skip, x.dtype)])); v_raw = svf_head(svf_norm_act(cast(x, svf_norm_act.compute_dtype))) cast float32. GroupRegLevelModel._call_deform: v = diffeo.center_velocities(v_raw); (u, u_inv) = diffeo.exp_and_inverse(v, integration_steps, lean). Linear: model.linear_decoder(bottleneck, task, training) -> (A_raw, params, feats); A = model.centering(A_raw). Cascade ops in models/cascade.py: pool_to_coarser, prewarp_linear(images, A_prev, spacing), compose_linear(R_raw, A_prev, centering), prewarp_deform(images, U) = diffeo.warp(float32 images, U), FrozenStage.linear/deform, FrozenChain._linear/_deform; diffeo.compose_cascade(U, U_inv, u, u_inv, lean), diffeo.upsample_displacement. Frozen stages: float32, built in cascade._float32_policy(), checkpoint keys frozen_stage (level-2 run) / frozen_stage_4 + frozen_stage_2 (level-1 run). Run config.json (runtime.checkpoint.write_config): {model_config, args{level, amp, split_group_conv, lean_sampler, deform_decoder_dtype?, fp16_act_clip?, ...}, cascade{fingerprint, stages[{level, checkpoint_key, fingerprint, origin_checkpoint, origin_step}]}}. Checkpoint helpers: runtime.checkpoint.resolve_checkpoint, source_config_path, fingerprints_match, weight_fingerprint, STEP_KEY, RunCheckpoint(ckpt_last, ckpt_best, model, opt, step, extra=frozen.checkpoint_extra()); runtime.logging.make_run_dir(root, name) -> paths dict (root, config, ckpt_last, ckpt_best). Trainer validation references: Trainer._val_fn(task, nv) / _val_deform_fn(nv) dispatch to _cascade_val_fn / _cascade_val_deform_fn (runtime/run.py 1179-1376), Trainer._deform_errors(labels, u, u_inv, v, v_raw, seed). main.py 217-223: configure_tf_precision first, then set_logical_device_configuration for --gpu-memory-limit-mb. SLURM scripts: header + container call pattern of slurm/eval_mindboggle.sh; static tests in tests/test_slurm_scripts.py (stdlib only, run TF-free in stage 1 of run_tests_wsl.sh).
directory_structure: models/ (Keras layers, GroupRegLevelModel, cascade, diffeo, transforms, precision), runtime/ (Trainer in run.py, checkpoint, args, metrics, fixed_data), data_loading/ (DALI pipelines, params.LEVEL_SHAPE/LEVEL_SPACING), evaluation/ (method-independent evaluator: `python -m evaluation run|check-convention`), tests/ (unittest modules, helpers, run_tests_wsl.sh), slurm/ (sbatch scripts), new: inference/ (package) + predict.py (CLI entry) + tests/predict_helpers.py + tests/test_predict_streaming.py + tests/test_predict.py + slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh. Task docs: .agents/tasks/predict-script/.
